name: steppe_grass
notes: Grazed chalk turf on an arena floor: short grass grazed and dried to tan, ankle-high and even, with the chalk showing through. Unlike the grasses of the downs it grows no stands of long grass (`src/mesh/sprites.rs` names it); its name holds `grass` so the straw (world.json `straw`) reaches it, so nothing on an arena floor is tall enough to hide in.
